biggest_catch: You must submit the referral form BEFORE your friend opens their membership, and the referral has to be identified at account opening. If your friend joins first and mentions you later, you get nothing — and they can't have been an FAFCU member in the previous 6 months.
catches: Referral form must be submitted before the new membership is opened; the referral must be identified at account opening.
Referred person must open and fund a new Regular Share Account and meet all eligibility conditions.
New member must not have been an FAFCU member within the previous 6 months.
Referring member must be in good standing.
Referrer's $50 deposited into their Regular Share Account during the next calendar month (rewards paid within 30 days after qualifications are met).
Bonuses may be reported for tax purposes if required; program may be modified or discontinued at any time.
No stated referral cap on the fetched page.
